title: Concurrency is not Parallelism by Rob Pike
summary: Rob Pike's Go talk distinguishing concurrency, the structuring of independent processes, from parallelism, their simultaneous execution. It uses Go channels and goroutines to illustrate.
why: The standard link for explaining the concurrency versus parallelism distinction and the motivations behind Go's concurrency model.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: here's an excellent talk on the same subject by Rob Pike that I link all the time to people
